newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 7.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on August 7. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Suharto opened the PT Kiani Kertas paper mill in East Kalimantan, one of the largest in Southeast Asia.
Military and political analysts say the government's decision to buy 12 Russian Sukhoi Su-30K jet fighters is a good one which will boost Indonesia's international and political clout.
Indonesian police shot dead a bank robber in the North Sulawesi provincial capital Manado after he took a hostage during a robbery.

Secretary-General of the Indonesian Moslem Intellectuals Association (ICMI) Adi Sasono said Information Minister Hartono, who this week said he wanted to join the influential group, would have the chance to become its leader at the next national meeting in the year 2000.
